text.en: Pellet final blows grant a stacking precision damage and reload speed buff. Precision hits with slugs extend the duration.

Scoring a pellet kill or landing 10 pellets grants one stack of 'On Black Wings' for 10 seconds. Maximum of 3 stacks. 

On Black Wings grants the following at 1|2|3| stacks:
• 15.6%|39%|54.7% increased precision damage
• ? Reload Speed
• ? Reload Speed Animation Duration

Precision Hits with slug rounds refresh buff duration.

Scoring a pellet kill or landing 10 pellets grants one stack of 'On Black Wings' for 10 seconds. Maximum of 3 stacks. 

On Black Wings grants the following at 1|2|3| stacks:
• 15.6%|39%|54.7% increased Slug Precision damage
• 3.5%|8.8%|12.4% increased Pellet Precision Damage
• ? Reload Speed
• ? Reload Speed Animation Duration
